mapper.select: SELECT w.id AS warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, p.id AS product_id, p.name AS product_name, s.count AS stock, pu.name AS unitName, pu.id AS unitId FROM erp_warehouse w JOIN erp_stock s ON w.id = s.warehouse_id JOIN erp_product p ON s.product_id = p.id -- 新增产品单位表关联 JOIN erp_product_unit pu ON p.unit_id = pu.id WHERE w.tenant_id = ${@cn.iocoder.yudao.framework.tenant.core.context.TenantContextHolder@getRequiredTenantId()} AND w.deleted = 0 AND s.deleted = 0 AND p.deleted = 0 AND pu.deleted = 0
